description: Browse the public grind-bounty board: vanity-address bounties requesters have escrowed for the worker fleet to grind. Filter by status (open / all / settled), sort by recency, reward, or expiry, and paginate. Each bounty shows its pattern, USDC amount, difficulty, status, and timing. Read-only; posting a bounty is a separate x402-paid write on the HTTP API.

sort.description: Order: newest first, biggest reward first, or soonest to expire. Default recency.

status.description: Which bounties to list. Default open.

name: vanity_board
title: Browse the vanity grind-bounty board
